summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching press releases announcing a strategic expansion into U.S. cell manufacturing, including a planned 1.5 GW HJT solar cell facility in Houston with a $357 million investment and two supply agreements totaling $185.6 million. The filing details corporate growth initiatives, not a special situation transaction. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of business expansion and operations. Nothing to watch from a special-situation perspective.
